rationale.verdict: Discovery phase incomplete. Core protocol documentation, GitHub source repos, and one token address on Etherscan have been located and cited. However, deployment artifacts in the GitHub /deployments folder could not be accessed directly, and no block-explorer-sourced contract addresses across the seven named chains have been catalogued. On-chain verification and systematic chain-by-chain enumeration (D1 block-explorer name-tag searches, D4 hardhat/foundry artifact extraction) remain necessary to populate admin_addresses[] and chain-specific contract roles. Without these, downstream control/exit/autonomy slices cannot proceed with certainty.

protocol_metadata.about: Derive V2 is a self-custodial, high-performance derivatives trading platform supporting options, perpetuals, and spot trading. The protocol consists of three components: Derive Chain (an OP Stack-based Optimistic rollup secured by Ethereum), the Derive Protocol (settlement layer enabling permissionless margin trading), and the Derive Exchange (orderbook operator). The system is governed by the Derive DAO.
